tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Re-prices one stay for exact dates and guests and returns a ZMRM booking link that opens the stay with the same dates and guests pre-filled. The quote carries priced_at and valid_until (advisory, not a hold). Payment always happens in ZMRM checkout; this tool never books or charges.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_booking_link" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
